SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
WEDNESDAY - APRIL 25, 2018 - CITY HALL -
07:00 P.M.
City Council Chamber
AGENDA MATERIALS: Reports and materials related to items on this Agenda are available for public inspection at the City Clerk's Office, Cerritos City Hall, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, Cerritos, CA 90703, during normal business hours, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., Monday through Friday, Telephone (562) 916-1248. Materials submitted to the City Council/Successor Agency after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's Office at the above address during normal business hours as noted.
PUBLIC COMMENTS: For all Agenda Items, except for Consent Calendar Items, public comments will be allowed at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered. The general public comments portion of the meeting, under Agenda Item 6, will not exceed 45 minutes, and no speaker will be allowed more than five minutes, unless determined appropriate by the Chair. To assist in the preparation of appropriate responses, persons are requested, but not required, to state their name and city of residence for the record.
PUBLIC HEARINGS: Public hearings will be conducted in the order indicated on the agenda, unless otherwise directed. Please complete and submit a blue Speakers Card if you wish to present testimony. Conduct of public hearings will occur in substantially the following sequence: the item to be heard is announced, a report of written correspondence and staff report are received, and the City Council asks questions of staff. The public hearing is opened and verbal testimony will occur in the following order: the applicant, if applicable, those in favor, opposed, or interested parties, and rebuttal by applicant. Speakers are requested, but not required, to state their name and city of residence for the record. After verbal testimony, the public hearing is closed and the matter is deliberated with a determination being made or a continuation of the matter.

MINUTES OF A SPECIAL MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL AND THE
SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT HELD ON APRIL 25,
2018, IN THE COUNCIL CHAMBERS AT CERRITOS CITY HALL, 18125 BLOOMFIELD
AVENUE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Invocation

  The invocation was given by Pastor Ryan Klements from New Life Community
  Church.

3.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was given by Girl Scout Troop 1403.

4.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council/Successor Agency were in attendance:

  Council/Agency Member Jim Edwards
  Council/Agency Member Naresh Solanki
  Council/Agency Member Frank A. Yokoyama
  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Mark E. Pulido
  Mayor/Chair Grace Hu

5.  Public Comments and Suggestions

  Sherman Kappe expressed concern regarding the 2017 Mayoral Transition.

  John Paul Drayer congratulated Mayor Hu for her work over the past year.

  Jay Gray spoke regarding the public’s right to address the City Council during public
  meetings.

6.  Introductions

  Mayor Hu introduced the dignitaries in attendance. Councilmembers Edwards,
  Solanki, and Yokoyama, Mayor Pro Tem Pulido, and Mayor Hu introduced family and
  guests in attendance.

7.  City Council/Successor Agency Reorganization. Selection of Mayor/Chair
  and Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair

  Vida Barone, City Clerk/Agency Secretary, declared the office of Mayor/Chair vacant
  and called for nominations for the office of Mayor/Chair.

  Council/Agency Member Yokoyama nominated Council/Agency Member Pulido for the
  office of Mayor/Chair.

  Council/Agency Member Edwards nominated Council/Agency Member Solanki for the
  office of Mayor/Chair.

  Noting there were no further nominations, the City Clerk declared nominations closed.
 City of Cerritos  April 25, 2018
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 2 of 3

7.  (continued)

  MOTION: Each member of the City Council/Successor Agency declared their vote for
  the Office of Mayor/Chair as follows: Pulido (Hu, Pulido, Yokoyama), Edwards (Edwards,
  Solanki). Council/Agency Member Pulido was selected, by acclamation (3 -2), to serve
  as Mayor/Chair.

  Mayor/Chair Pulido assumed the Mayoral seat at the dais and declared the Office of
  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair vacant. He called for nomination for the Office of Mayor Pro
  Tem/Vice Chair.

  Council/Agency Member Yokoyama nominated Council/Agency Member Solanki for the
  office of Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair.

  Council/Agency Member Solanki nominated Council/Agency Member Edwards for the
  office of Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair.

  Noting there were no further nominations, Mayor/Chair Pulido declared nominations
  closed.

  MOTION: Each member of the City Council/Successor Agency declared their vote for
  the Office of Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair as follows: Solanki (Hu, Pulido, Yokoyama),
  Edwards (Edwards, Solanki). Council/Agency Member Solanki was selected, by
  acclamation (3 -2), to serve as Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair.

  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Solanki assumed the Mayor Pro Tem seat at the dais.

8.  Comments from newly designated Mayor/Chair

  Comments were made by Mayor/Chair Pulido.

9.  Newly designated Mayor/Chair makes presentation to immediate past
  Mayor/Chair

  A video was displayed highlighting former Mayor Hu’s year of service and a special
  presentation to the former Mayor was made by her Council/Agency Member
  colleagues.

10.  Presentations from special guests

  Presentations were made to former Mayor Hu by various representatives.

11.  Council/Agency Member Comments

  Comments were provided by Council/Agency Members Edwards, Hu, and
  Yokoyama, Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Solanki, and Mayor/Chair Pulido.

12.  Mayor’s Invitation to Reception

  Mayor/Chair Pulido invited the community to a reception at the Cerritos Center for
  the Performing Arts.
 City of Cerritos  April 25, 2018

13.  Adjournment

  The meeting was adjourned at 8:24 p.m.
